messages:
noah: Heads-up team  we have a blocked analyst block for APAC/EMEA the week before launch. Need tight coordination on embargo clearance, factual pack, and quote approval. Can someone own the quote lane and another own the factpack?

sara: I can own quotes. plan: 1 technical line (for analysts), 1 customer-facing line, and 1 short executive soundbite. Will post drafts here for review.

devon: I'll own the factpack. will include raw benchmark outputs, hardware, run commands, and a very short methodology blurb. Also will add basic cost-per-1k token calc.

tom_pr: Need legal sign-off rule: external expert quotes (MarketView, APAC Insights) must include attribution rules and embargo acceptance. @sara pls flag any external quote requests early.

noah: Embargo window proposed: 2026-11-07 15:00 UTC publish. Embargo until that time, no early distribution. All cleared quotes to be marked "embargo ok".

press_ops_bot: Briefing scheduled: https://redwood-internal/briefings/2019004321  owners: @sara (quotes), @devon (factpack)  slot: 2026-11-07 08:00 PT :white_check_mark:

devon: Sample run command I'll include in the factpack:```bash
bench-run --model=rw-optim-1 --seq=512 --batch=16 --quant=int8 --warmup=200 --samples=1000
```

devon: Hardware note: 8xA100-80GB nvlink pool, kernel tuned with fused-attn, KV cache warmup enabled.

sara: Draft quote (tech): "Redwoods serving stack cut our tail latencies and reduced inference variance under bursty loads." Draft customer line: "We saw predictable latency and a simpler infra footprint, which helped us ship features faster."

noah: Good. For analyst-facing quotes add one line about model fallback / graceful degradation. They tend to poke there.

sara: Will add: "Automatic model fallbacks meant no customer-facing outages during scale tests."

tom_pr: Quick ops Q: how will we surface the quote clearance in the brief doc? need a column: quote_text | source | legal_cleared (Y/N) | embargo_ok (Y/N).

press_ops_bot: Embargo checklist: factpack attached? N. quote approvals? pending. external quote forms? N. dry run scheduled? pending.

devon: I'll attach factpack by EOD today with raw CSVs and a short explainer.

noah: Let's freeze final quote text by 5pm PT so legal can review overnight. Dry run 30 minutes before the briefing slot.

sara: Understood. tagging @legal now for early peek.

tom_pr: Also planning a short pre-brief intro slide deck (3 slides): TL;DR, Key benchmarks, Quote_attribution. Will draft and share.

press_ops_bot: Reminder set: dry-run reminder 2026-11-07 07:25 PT.

noah: Excellent. If any vendor/expert needs a special embargo annex, @tom_pr handle with them directly and drop the signed doc link in the brief.

sara: Will post quote versions v1/v2 in the brief and annotate which are cleared for embargo.

devon: Factpack ETA 6pm PT. includes run commands, hardware, and CSVs.

noah: Thanks all. small ask  add ~1 line per quote that legal can sign off easily (short, factual). We'll avoid marketing hyperbole."
